about: The report's verdict is judged once, at the end, from each check's findings: a reasonless directive reports fail. (Skipping that judgement is caught by jpt-verdict-on-lab-ignore, where the status before it is stale; here directive-reason's own is already right.) Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE jpcheck/lab.py tests/test_check_directive_reason.py tests/mutants/jpt-verdict-on-lab-directives.json

mutants.name: the check never fails
mutants.target: a reasonless shellcheck directive fails the gate
